Spurs 112Mavericks 111

Wemby's 52, and a one-point escape

Final · Wed, Nov 4 · San Antonio

San Antonio led by 19, made just 5 threes, and still held off Dallas behind a 52-24-8 night from Victor Wembanyama.

1 · First half

How it started.

The Spurs led 32–26 after one quarter. At the half, the Spurs led 68–51.

Scroll to keep going ↓
2 · The difference

Wemby did everything

52 points on 16-of-28 shooting, 19-of-23 at the line, 24 rebounds and 8 blocks.

3 · How it turned

They won without the three

The Spurs made 5 of 36 from deep but scored 62 in the paint and made 33 of 39 free throws.

4 · Where it was won

They survived the comeback

Dallas won the second half 60–44 and had it down to one at the buzzer.

5 · Final

Spurs 112, Mavericks 111.

Q1Q2Q3Q4F
DAL26252931111
SAS32362222112

From the Mavericks’ side: Lost the second quarter 25–36, then won the rest of the game 60–44.

What it meant: the Spurs are 10–2, 2nd in the West, with 96% top-6 odds now. The Mavericks are 7–5, 10th in the West, at 13%.

2 · The play of the game

The winner.

Wembanyama's free throw with 24.2 seconds left that broke a 111–111 tie.
